name: smwgraphics-hounourville-city
title: Hounourville City
description:
A FG that I whipped up for the world 3 levels of my hack which are set in the futuristic city of Hounourville. This tileset was slightly inspired by deBlob and Opelucid City from Pokemon Black.

This tileset provides a plethora of tiles to use, yet it all fits snugly into one GFX slot. Use with FG3.

Credit would be nice, as this tileset is 100% custom, but I won't make you do it.

Update: Converted bin to MAP16 format, and added a sample level.
